story.title: Device Card & Connection Status
story.iWant: to see my device connection status and connect/disconnect
story.soThat: I know when my device is ready

acceptance-criteria.criterion: When a device is selected, Device Card shows device name and chipset
Connection status dot reflects current state (gray=disconnected, pulsing=connecting, green=connected, red=error)
Disconnected state shows gray dot and "Connect Device" button
Connected state shows green dot, device info, and "Disconnect" button
Error state shows red dot and error message

tasks.task: Create DeviceCard component Create src/components/features/device/DeviceCard.tsx Display device name from deviceStore.selectedDevice.name Display chipset from deviceStore.selectedDevice.chipset Create card layout with shadcn/ui Card component Conditionally render based on device selected state Show placeholder when no device selected

Create ConnectionStatusDot component Create src/components/features/device/ConnectionStatusDot.tsx Accept status prop: 'disconnected' | 'connecting' | 'connected' | 'error' Disconnected: gray dot (bg-zinc-500) Connecting: pulsing animation (animate-pulse bg-yellow-500) Connected: green dot (bg-green-500) Error: red dot (bg-red-500) Use CSS keyframes for smooth pulse animation

Add i18n translations Add translation keys to src/i18n/en.json Add Vietnamese translations to src/i18n/vi.json

Testing and verification Run npm run dev and verify no TypeScript errors Test DeviceCard displays selected device info Test status dot colors for all states Test pulse animation during connecting Test connect/disconnect button functionality Test error state display Test UI responds to store changes

docs.doc: Describes the Protocol Bridge Hook pattern for wrapping WebUSBManager with React hooks. useWebUSB hook uses singleton ref, lazy initialization, automatic deviceStore sync, and terminal logging.
DeviceState interface: selectedDevice, isConnected, connectionError, firehoseLoaded. Data flow: User Action → Component → Hook → Core Logic → Store → UI Update.
All components follow: hooks at top, derived state, handlers with useCallback, render with cn(). Use useTranslation for i18n, styled with Tailwind utilities.
Story definition: Device Card shows device name, chipset, connection status dot. States: disconnected (gray), connecting (pulse), connected (green), error (red). Buttons: Connect Device, Disconnect.
Loading states pattern: idle | loading | success | error. Error handling: terminalStore.log() + toast + UI display. CSS keyframes for pulse animation established.
Card uses bg-zinc-900 with border-zinc-800. Status dot: 8px circle with subtle glow effect. Device name: text-sm font-medium text-zinc-100. Chipset: text-xs text-zinc-400.

constraints.constraint: Use Hook Wrapper Pattern: wrap useWebUSB hook, sync with deviceStore, log to terminalStore
Component Pattern: hooks at top, useCallback for handlers, cn() for styling
Import order: React → third-party → stores → hooks → components → types → utils
Error flow: catch in hook → log to terminal (technical) → show toast (user-friendly) → update error state
CRITICAL: Core logic (src/core/*, src/auth/*, src/services/*) must NOT be modified
Status dot colors: gray (disconnected), yellow+pulse (connecting), green (connected), red (error)
Buttons must be disabled during connecting state to prevent duplicate actions
